title: Vanilla Rice Krispies Treats
description: Chewy marshmallow squares with real vanilla and a pinch of salt.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, plus more for the pan
steps: Melt the butter over low heat in a large pot. Add the marshmallows and stir until just melted.
Remove from the heat. Stir in the vanilla and salt, then fold in the cereal until coated.
Transfer to the pan and lightly press into an even layer with a buttered spatula. Cool for 30 minutes before cutting into squares.
imageAlt: Stacked vanilla marshmallow cereal squares on a cream plate
